title: XR Interaction Toolkit
description: Unity's XR Interaction Toolkit provides a high-level, component-based interaction system for creating VR and AR experiences. EML uses the XR Interaction Toolkit for implementing intuitive hand tracking, locomotion, and object manipulation in Unity VR projects.
